description: Unified document core (docx_engine) owns template tagging and filling; no generation logic in frontend.
Cross-run XML replacement: user-selected text spanning multiple runs tagged correctly.
Fill operation detects unclosed tags ({{) and returns structured error.
Template documents stored on filesystem; SQLite stores paths and metadata only.
Binary IPC replaces Base64 string bridging for large documents.
PDF export does not require LibreOffice; uses bundled/headless renderer.
Export formats: DOCX, PDF, HTML preview, .dfpkg bundle.
Template Creator: upload DOCX, define 5 field types, preview, save.
Template Filler: fill values, preview, export with inline validation.
Template versioning: draft/review/published/archived states and rollback.
RBAC roles: viewer, filler, creator, approver, admin.
Approval workflow: draft -> review -> published.
Immutable exportable audit log for all generation events.
Admin console for users, seats, licenses, audit logs, and reports.
Offline activation: Pro, Business, Enterprise signed offline files.
CLI, REST bridge, and webhooks for headless automation.
Strict CSP in Tauri; sanitized preview rendering.
DOCX validation, zip bomb limits, and path traversal guards.
Local DPAPI encryption at rest; zero-knowledge licensing.
Opt-in telemetry consent dialog; default deny.
SSO/SAML authentication and on-prem air-gapped builds.
Signed auto-update, staged rollout, and SBOM generation.
